brief:
Today, Tuesday 29 September, is Legs A, the first leg night of Meso 3, the four-week building block. Every number tonight comes from what you actually lifted in the last week at the Warsaw gym, not from the old gym. That is why the app's own suggestions (145 on leg curl, 240 on calves, 65 on the crunch) are replaced: they came from machines you no longer use, which is what you called out on 21 September.

Two lifts go up. Leg curl: 110 for 12 on the first set, then 120 for 10 on the last two, because you got 110 for 12 on both sets on 24 September. Leg press (feet low): 140 for 10, 160 for 10, then 170 for 8, because you did 160 for 11 on 21 September. If tonight's leg press is a different machine from that night, start at 160 for 10 instead. Everything else keeps its weight and asks for one more rep: split squat with the 7 kg dumbbells for 10 on both sets; leg extension 105 for 13 on both sets; both hip machines at 41 kg for 13; calf raise 220 for 13 on all three sets; cable crunch 50 for 11 on all three sets. Sets go back to full after the deload week.

No pain or soreness shows in any note. Please step on a scale: your last weigh-in was 207 lb on 23 August, 37 days ago, with the show 153 days out.
